messages:
ashley: Heads-up — opened PR to migrate the console dashboard sample and tracing hook snippets to SDK v2.0. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2143 :clipboard:

ashley: The PR contains: updated dashboard widget JSON, tracing hook examples (node + python), and a revised cost/latency breakdown paragraph. Preview: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/2143 :eyes:

kevin: nice. can we confirm the dashboard sample still renders in narrow screens? last migration clipped the legend. :thinking_face:

maya: i'll take the responsive check. quick question — did you keep the old metric keys so existing customers' dashboards don't break?

ashley: yes — kept backward-compatible metric keys, but added a note under "migration notes" about the new cost_key that powers the breakdown widget.

samir: quick skim — node snippet uses old `tracing.startSpan` signature. needs to show new `Tracing.start('name', {attributes})` shape. i'll add a small diff in the PR.

ashley: thanks. adding you as reviewer @samir.

docs-bot: Automated check — broken links: 1. /sdk/node/tracing -> fixed redirect in branch. Lint: 0 warnings. Preview build: succeeded.

ryan: real nit: the cost/latency paragraph mentions "per-token cost" but our billing metric is `token_units`. please use consistent terminology for legal copy.

olivia: i'll update copy to `token_units` + add a tiny footnote about rounding.

maya: responsive test results: legend still wraps awkwardly at 320px. two options — collapse legend into a toggle or move legend below chart. which do we prefer?

kevin: prefer toggle (keeps visual density). but make sure keyboard accessible.

ashley: toggle sounds good. samir, can you coordinate adding the ARIA attributes if you touch the widget JSON?

samir: yep. will put a small snippet: ```json
{"legend": {"position": "toggle", "ariaLabel": "Toggle legend"}}
```

ashley: also cc'ing @ryan for final legal word check after olivia's update.

ryan: happy to sign off once copy is switched to `token_units`.

olivia: copy updated in PR. moved the technical note to the bottom and added example output.

kevin: small example tweak for the tracing snippet (python) — use context manager pattern for readability: ```python
with Tracing.span("handle_request") as span:
    span.set_attribute("route", "/generate")
    ...
```

samir: merged my snippet fixes into the branch and added the ARIA attrs. tested locally.

docs-bot: Preview updated: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/2143 — checks passing.

ashley: final checklist before merge: 1) accessibility ✅ (samir) 2) responsive legend ✅ (maya + toggle) 3) copy `token_units` ✅ (olivia + ryan) 4) examples use SDK v2 signatures ✅ (samir + kevin) 5) link redirects in place ✅ (docs-bot)

maya: i'll run the e2e rendering test on staging in ~15m and report back here.

kevin: let's aim to merge by EOD if staging looks good. :shipit:

maya: e2e pass on staging. one tiny visual gap at 375px fixed by a single CSS rule — added to PR.

ashley: amazing, merging after another quick approval from ryan. thanks everyone! :tada:

ryan: approved — merging now. please monitor the console metrics for the next 24h for any regression in the cost widget.

ashley: will keep an eye and will create a rollback plan in case of issues. thanks all.
